headline: Watchmen CGI Doesn't Hold Up, Jeffrey Dean Morgan Says, but He's Proud of Fight Scene
summary: Jeffrey Dean Morgan admits *Watchmen*'s CGI looks dated almost 20 years later. The Comedian actor remains proud of his memorable fight scene with Ozymandias. Snyder's film adapted the beloved Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons comic.

headline: Pokémon Go Black Market for Rare Creatures Confirmed, Leading to Player Bans
summary: Pokémon Go players are reportedly banned for fraudulently acquiring rare creatures. Reports confirm a long-rumored black market selling 'injected' rare questlines. Speculation arises about insider involvement in the illicit trade.

headline: Jeffrey Dean Morgan Still Receives Fan Harassment for Negan's Actions 10 Years Later
summary: Jeffrey Dean Morgan says fans still confront him angrily over Negan's actions. People swear at him in the street a decade after Glenn's death. The actor plays the villain in *The Walking Dead*.

headline: Saber CEO Admits 'Dig' at Gearbox Boss Randy Pitchford in New Game Trailer
summary: Saber CEO admits taking a 'dig' at Gearbox boss Randy Pitchford in a new game trailer. He says it's payback for Pitchford's alleged 'shots at Embracer in Borderlands 4'. The public beef surfaced via the *Rideshare Stimulator* trailer.

headline: Trump Hid in Catering Truck for Secret Plane Swap Over Iran Threat, Reports Say
summary: Reports suggest former US President Trump hid in a catering truck for a secret plane swap. This covert operation was reportedly aimed at evading an Iran threat. Reporters were falsely informed he was on Air Force One during the ruse.

headline: Amber Met Office Extreme Heat Warning Issued as UK Temperatures Could Hit 38C
summary: The Met Office has issued an amber extreme heat warning for Thursday. Temperatures in the UK are expected to reach up to 38C during the peak. The warning signals significant health risks and potential disruption.

headline: Eclipse Chasers Scramble for Glasses as UK Stocks Run Low Ahead of Major Event
summary: Specialist eclipse glasses are nearly sold out online across the UK. Enthusiasts are scrambling to secure glasses for the upcoming celestial event. It will be the UK's most significant eclipse since 1999.

headline: Zelensky Alleges Russia Using North Korean Missiles in Ukraine Strikes
summary: Ukraine's President Zelensky claims Russia used North Korean missiles in recent strikes. Attacks in Zaporizhzhia resulted in at least six deaths and 19 injuries. Zelensky asserts ballistic missiles from Russia's ally were involved.
